headlines.description: Manchester United made a nightmare start to the new season as promoted Hull confounded their many doubters by securing a shock 2-0 victory on their Premier League return.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man United slip to surprise Hull PL defeat

headlines.description: Bruno Fernandes' hat trick helped Manchester United bounce back from their humiliation against Hull City and a poor start against Ipswich to secure a 5-2 comeback victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fernandes nets hat trick as Man Utd rout Ipswich
